cells.gaps: The newest figure, 2.77 per cent for 2026, is above 2 per cent. A UCC telecom tax study of 2026 puts mobile data at about UGX 5,000 a gigabyte, against UCC's UGX 2,000 in October 2026; the study gives no month.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-11-21: the UCC's tax study figure of about UGX 5,000 a gigabyte (UGA-009) carries only the year 2026, and the regulator's own statements of 13 and 26 October 2026 put the price at UGX 2,000 (UGA-007, UGA-008), so the October figure stays the newest. 5 GB at that price is 2.77 per cent of monthly income, so 3.
